facts.text: Drop Dead Ned offers to hire himself and his killer wasp to the party for 100 gold for the week, doing anything as long as he gets to kill people; he would refund 5 gold for each killing he is allowed if he can do what he wants with the victims.

classification.support_basis: Ned would add a killer and his wasp to the party, but play established no specific want or debt his service would advance.
classification.action_basis: Ned actually offered his terms to Dr. Uriah, who said he would think about it, but no concrete advantage toward a party want was established.
classification.opening_basis: Trigger: paying Ned 100 gold for the week. Benefit: a hired killer with a killer wasp, but no specific advantage toward a party want or debt was linked in play.
